findings.entity: olives arriving in glass jar vs small glass bowl source
findings.description: At 00:00.250 the source glass bowl clearly holds only bright green olives, yet from 00:00.500 onward dark purple/black olives fall into the jar, and by 00:01.750 roughly half the jar's olives are dark. No dark olives were ever visible in the source.

findings.entity: glass jar fill vs small glass bowl capacity
findings.description: The small shallow glass bowl holds roughly 8-10 olives at 00:00.250 and is never refilled during the first pour, yet the jar accumulates ~20-24 olives by 00:02.750-00:03.000. More olives arrive than the source could have held.

findings.entity: glass bowl contents during second pour
findings.description: The glass bowl was refilled from a handful scooped out of the steel bowl, which contained only green olives (00:04.500-00:05.000). At 00:06.750-00:07.250 the glass bowl now contains dark purple olives that were never in the steel bowl.

findings.entity: glass jar fill level after second pour
findings.description: Before the second pour the jar held ~20-24 olives; the glass bowl added at most ~10. By 00:09.000 the jar holds ~40+ olives filled to near the shoulder, with the majority now dark purple, which is more than the transfer can explain. The camera angle changed at ~00:06, so this is lower confidence.
After the scoop the steel bowl shows ~2 green olives (00:05.250), but from 00:06.750 it shows ~5-6 green olives with no visible refill. Brown items also appear that were not visible before the scoop.

The pouring vessel starts as a shallow, round-bottomed small glass bowl (00:00.250) but by 00:08.750-00:09.000 it is a taller straight-sided cylindrical tumbler. Its shape and proportions changed between shots.
